title: Update YES agreement message text and bullet list

requirements.text:
Update the YES-click agreement message content shown in the Valentine invitation screen (in frontend/src/App.tsx) so it displays exactly this headline and bullet list (and no additional trailing sentence):

Headline (exact text):
"By clicking YES you agree to:"

Bullets (exact text, in this order):
- "Unlimited cuddles"
- "Lifetime supply of milk"
- "Unlimited sex"
- "Daily minimum 1 nudes"

quotes:
Reveal a message: “By clicking YES you agree to:

- Unlimited cuddles
- Lifetime supply of milk
- Unlimited sex
- Daily minimum 1 nudes

acceptanceCriteria: After clicking the "YES" button, the agreement message becomes visible immediately.
The agreement message headline text is exactly: "By clicking YES you agree to:"
The agreement message shows exactly four bullet items, in the exact order and wording specified: Unlimited cuddles; Lifetime supply of milk; Unlimited sex; Daily minimum 1 nudes.
The agreement message contains no additional sentence such as "Effective immediately! 🚀" (or any other extra line) beyond the headline and four bullets.
All other YES-click behaviors remain unchanged (buttons hide after 1 second; confetti runs for 5 seconds).

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not route any static assets through the backend.
Keep backend as a single Motoko actor; only add migration.mo if state schema changes (not expected for this request).
nonGoals: Changing the 404 screen behavior or text.
Changing YES/NO button animations, positions, or the NO-click behavior beyond preserving existing functionality.
Adding sound effects or new visual effects.
